thesis: The page is a dark room with one work light on the floor: an SVG raking beam skims every drawn wall surface, and nothing is called finished until it is graded L0-L5 under that light.

signature.name: Side-Light Grade Strip
signature.summary: A six-cell L0-L5 strip (GA-214) with a lit cell and a mono 'checked at 8 deg' note, paired with an SVG feDiffuseLighting wall surface whose light azimuth is driven by --sw-p so shadows rake across bumps. Hero: masked h1 letters lit by the beam; finish-level story: strip steps L0 to L5 as the surface flattens; texture swatches and review chips carry their grade; footer strip reads L5 and the light switches off.

palette.family: Unlit Room + Worklight Bone + Level Cyan

layoutMoves: full-bleed masked display h1 over a lit procedural wall, tool panel docked right on a 7/5 split
every section header is a grade strip row: level cell left, section title, mono 'how we check' note right
one primed-white (t-light) band only at the quote form: the room light comes on when the wall is done
price ledger set as an inspection readout table in mono with tabular figures
asymmetric 4/8 proof grid: rating dial left, review cards with grade chips right

motion.intro: On load the beam (SVG distant-light azimuth 200deg to 165deg, elevation 6 to 14) sweeps once across the masked h1 in 1.1s, then stays still; skipped on any scroll/keypress.
stories: Finish levels: pinned 220svh on desktop, --sw-p raises the strip from L0 to L5 while the drawn wall goes from taped seams to flat (surfaceScale 6 to 0) - verb: dial
Texture matcher: as each swatch enters, the light rakes across it once and its shadows draw in - verb: wipe
motion.hover: Cards and swatches: a 120deg linear-gradient side-light slides 30% across the surface on hover/focus (light from the left, never a lift or shadow).
